title: Twenty One Pilots Hosting Live IMAX Film Online Watch Party, Dropping ‘More Than We Ever Imagined (Live in Mexico City)’ Album
summary: The film and album were both recorded during the Ohio duo's biggest-show ever in Mexico City on their 2025 Clancy world tour.
contentText:
Twenty One Pilots are gearing up for one more visit to the site of their biggest live triumph. The Columbus, Ohio-bred duo announced on Thursday (July 16) that fans will get another chance to watch their IMAX concert film, Twenty One Pilots: More Than We Ever Imagined , beginning on Aug. 8, with streaming provided by Kiswe.

The band will also host an online watch party on Aug. 8 that will feature Q&A with singer Tyler Joseph and drummer Josh Dun after the screening to discuss the movie that was shot in front of a sold-out crowd of 65,000 at Estadio GNP Seguros in Mexico City on the band’s 2024-2025 world tour. The special screening will allow fans to watch the film simultaneously and take part in interactive features, including a live chat. Tickets for the screening are available now; to buy tickets for the watch party click here . Following the watch party, the film, which opened in theaters worldwide on Feb. 26, will be available for on-demand purchase until Aug. 22.

In addition, 21P are releasing an accompanying live concert album, More Than We Ever Imagined (Live in Mexico City) , which will be available on all DSPs on Aug. 7. The album is available for pre-order now in several limited-edition formats, including a Digipak CD, a 2LP red vinyl in a gatefold jacket and a deluxe photo book edition double-LP. The deluxe edition is a hardcover photobook with oversized accordion-fold pages with live photography and artwork, as well as a collection of oversized prints.

21P will bring it all back home on Oct. 17 with a show at Columbus’ Ohio Stadium featuring Death Cab For Cutie in front of 62,000 fans, marking the biggest U.S. headline show of their career. The duo are currently on the road on an international festival run that includes July and August dates in Europe and a late-summer/fall round in North and South America that will hit: Osheaga in Montreal (July 31), Sommo Festival in Cavendish, Prince Edward Island (Sept. 11), Rock in Rio in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Sept. 13), Shaky Knees in Atlanta (Sept. 19), Oceans Calling in Ocean City, Md. (Sept. 26), Austin City Limits in Austin, Texas (Oct. 4 and 11), and Corona Capital in Mexico City (Nov. 21).
